# netgear Provider

Manages NETGEAR WAX210 (AX1800) Wi-Fi 6 access points in standalone mode through their web UI.

The device allows only one logged in session at a time. Running Terraform logs out a user of the web UI and vice versa.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    netgear = {
      source = "negineri/netgear-ap"
    }
  }
}

provider "netgear" {
  endpoint = "https://192.168.0.100"
  # username = "admin"            # default
  # password = "..."              # or NETGEAR_AP_PASSWORD
  # insecure = true               # default, the device uses a self-signed certificate
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `apply_timeout` (Number) Maximum number of seconds to wait for the device to apply changes. Defaults to `180`.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the access point, e.g. `https://192.168.0.100`. Can also be set with the `NETGEAR_AP_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. Defaults to `true` because the device uses a self-signed certificate. Can also be set with the `NETGEAR_AP_INSECURE` environment variable.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Login password. Can also be set with the `NETGEAR_AP_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `username` (String) Login user name. Defaults to `admin`. Can also be set with the `NETGEAR_AP_USERNAME` environment variable.
